routes.label: Character progression
routes.description: The player is trying to continue a character-related route or is unsure what to do next with a particular character.

routes.label: Story progression
routes.description: The player has completed an event or part of the story and is unsure where to continue.

routes.label: Event or requirement
routes.description: The player believes an event should be available but it has not appeared or progressed.

routes.label: Location or access problem
routes.description: The player cannot find the required location, area, or interaction needed to continue.

routes.label: General progression problem
routes.description: The player is stuck but cannot identify a specific character, event, location, or technical problem.

routes.label: Technical problem
routes.description: The player is experiencing an installation, loading, save, update, or other technical problem.
